title: Receivables / Payables
intro: Open balances only. Settled items are reflected in Money Balance and removed from this list.

collect.title: Collect payment — receivable #{{id}}
collect.hint: Enter what the customer paid now toward this open balance. Remaining {{amount}} {{currency}} — you can collect in partial payments until the balance is cleared.

receivablesTable.title: Accounts Receivable
receivablesTable.hint: Outstanding balances on completed sales (after any order advance). Customer prepayments before a sale are listed under Payables.

payablesTable.title: Accounts Payable
payablesTable.hint: Supplier, courier, and package obligations, plus customer prepayments on on-demand orders until you sell (deposit rows drop off once the order is sold and the advance is applied).

payableContext.customerDeposit: On-demand prepayment — cleared when you sell from this order
payableContext.returnRefund: Refund owed to the customer for a returned item
payableContext.courierChange: Change the courier gave at the door

notifications.amountRequired: Enter the amount collected (greater than zero).
notifications.amountExceeds: Collected amount cannot exceed remaining balance ({{balance}}).
notifications.confirmSettlePayable: Mark this payable as paid and deduct from Money Balance?
notifications.confirmRefundDeposit: Return this customer deposit to the customer? Money Balance will decrease and the deposit liability will be cleared.
notifications.confirmPayDispatchFee: Pay the courier fee for this sale? Money Balance will decrease and profit will fall by the same amount.
notifications.payDispatchFeeFailed: Could not pay the courier fee.
notifications.confirmCancelDispatchFee: Cancel this courier fee? The courier will not be paid and Money Balance is unchanged.
notifications.cancelDispatchFeeFailed: Could not cancel the courier fee.
notifications.confirmReimburseCourierChange: Pay the courier back the change he gave the customer at the door?
